# Pashabakess — https://pashabakess.alwaysdata.net/
# Every search engine and AI assistant is welcome (Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot,
# PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot …):
# the rules below apply to all of them. Only the admin portal and the ordering API are off limits.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
# Search engines may read the live menu when rendering pages.
Allow: /api/menu.php

Sitemap: https://pashabakess.alwaysdata.net/sitemap.xml
